proof_inventory.expected_proposition: ∀ {Γ : List Allow.Ty} {e : Allow.Raw} {t : Allow.Ty}, Allow.inferType Γ e = some t → Allow.HasType Γ e t
∀ {Γ : List Allow.Ty} {e : Allow.Raw} {t : Allow.Ty}, Allow.HasType Γ e t → Allow.HoleFree e
∀ {Γ : List Allow.Ty} {t : Allow.Ty} {e : Allow.Raw}, Allow.checkSlot Γ t e = true → Allow.HasType Γ e t
∀ (s : Allow.State) (base : Nat) (Γ : List Allow.Ty) (e : Allow.Raw), ¬ (base = s.revision ∧ Allow.checkSlot Γ Allow.Ty.formula e = true) → Allow.commit s base Γ e = s
∀ (s : Allow.State) (base : Nat) (Γ : List Allow.Ty) (e : Allow.Raw), s.Valid → (Allow.commit s base Γ e).Valid
∀ (s : Allow.State) (Γ : List Allow.Ty) (e : Allow.Raw), Allow.checkSlot Γ Allow.Ty.formula e = true → (Allow.commit s s.revision Γ e).revision = s.revision + 1
∀ {p : Allow.Presentation} {e : Allow.Evidence}, Allow.visible p e = true → e.key = p.key ∧ e.epoch = p.epoch ∧ p.draftHash = p.key.sourceHash
∀ {n : Nat} (a b : Allow.Formula n), Allow.canonical a = Allow.canonical b ↔ ∀ (v : Fin n → Bool), Allow.eval v a = Allow.eval v b
∀ {n : Nat} {a b : Allow.Formula n}, Allow.Certificate a b → ∀ (v : Fin n → Bool), Allow.eval v a = Allow.eval v b
∀ {n : Nat} {a b : Allow.ContextualFormula n}, Allow.CertifiedMerge a b → Allow.canonicalKey a = Allow.canonicalKey b
∀ (k : Allow.CommandKind) (s : Allow.SolverStatus), Allow.report k s ≠ Allow.Conclusion.unboundedValidity

∀ (k : Allow.CommandKind) (s : Allow.SolverStatus), s = Allow.SolverStatus.UNKNOWN ∨ s = Allow.SolverStatus.TIMEOUT ∨ s = Allow.SolverStatus.CANCELLED ∨ s = Allow.SolverStatus.ERROR → ¬ Allow.Absence (Allow.report k s)
∀ {s : Allow.RetrievalScope} {rows : List Allow.Row} {r : Allow.Row}, r ∈ Allow.retrieve s rows → r.scope = s ∧ r.deleted = false ∧ r.permitted = true

∀ {target : Allow.TargetContext} {pool : Allow.Polarity} {run : Allow.Run} {w : Allow.Witness}, Allow.admitPair target pool run w = true → run.query.target = target ∧ run.query.polarity = pool ∧ w.ownQuery = run.query ∧ run.status = Allow.SolverStatus.SAT ∧ w.validated = true
∃ c : Allow.KernelConfig, c = Allow.generatedKernel ∧ Allow.Coherent c
((∃ _ : Empty, True) ∨ True) ∧ ¬ (∃ _ : Empty, True ∨ True)
∀ {n : Nat} (t : Allow.Table n), Allow.tabulate n (Allow.lookup t) = t
∀ {n : Nat} (a b : Allow.ContextualFormula n), a.inventory ≠ b.inventory → Allow.canonicalKey a ≠ Allow.canonicalKey b
∀ (p : Allow.Presentation) (e : Allow.Evidence) (draft : String), e.epoch = p.epoch → Allow.visible (Allow.edit p draft) e = false
Allow.inferType [] (.existsRel 7 (.someRel (.ref 0))) = some .formula
Allow.inferType [.relation 7 []] (.and (.ref 0) .truth) = none
(Allow.commit ⟨[], .truth, 0⟩ 0 [] (.not .truth)).revision = 1
Allow.visible ⟨Allow.sampleKey, 4, "source"⟩ ⟨Allow.sampleKey, 4⟩ = true

Allow.admitPair Allow.sampleTarget .positive ⟨Allow.positiveQuery, .SAT⟩ ⟨Allow.positiveQuery, "instanceA", true⟩ = true ∧ Allow.admitPair Allow.sampleTarget .negative ⟨Allow.negativeQuery, .SAT⟩ ⟨Allow.negativeQuery, "instanceB", true⟩ = true ∧ Allow.positiveQuery ≠ Allow.negativeQuery
Allow.canonical (Allow.Formula.truth : Allow.Formula 1) ≠ Allow.canonical Allow.Formula.falsity

provenance.public_claim: Every successful raw-expression inference has a derivation in the declared typing judgment.
Every derivably typed expression is free of holes.
An accepted typed slot has the exact expected type under the supplied elaborated context.
A failed or stale accepted-state transaction returns the previous accepted state exactly.
Every accepted model-state transition preserves the well-typed committed expression invariant.
A successful candidate transaction increments the accepted revision exactly once.
Visible current evidence has the exact accepted analysis key and presentation epoch, and the draft matches the accepted source.
Truth-table canonical equality iff all Boolean valuations agree, for a fixed atom count and ordering.
Every derivation in the registered Boolean certificate calculus preserves evaluation.
Certified same-context Boolean merges preserve canonical table identity.
No solver status in the reporting policy returns an unbounded-validity claim.
UNKNOWN/TIMEOUT/CANCELLED/ERROR do not yield bounded absence evidence.
The abstract retrieval filter returns only same-tenant, live, permitted rows in the selected model/schema.
Admitted witness-pool membership binds a common target context, own query identity, validation and expected query polarity; positive and negative queries need not share their query IDs.
The frozen formal-kernel configuration has an explicit coherent, non-release, RAG-disabled witness.
Unrestricted existential hoisting across disjunction has a concrete empty-domain counterexample.
Tabulating evaluation of a canonical table returns the identical table.
Different ordered exact atom inventories cannot have equal contextual canonical keys, even if truth tables coincide.
A presentation edit invalidates prior current evidence even if the accepted analysis key is unchanged.
Contract conforms to schema, retains six user invariants, and has unique frozen obligations.
Formal-kernel JSON deterministically regenerates the identical Lean constants.
Six concrete non-vacuity witnesses inhabit the frozen expected Lean propositions.
Two isolated clean builds agree on proof inventory, correspondence, projection and olean hashes.
Lean source and axiom audit contains no prohibited proof escapes or undeclared axioms.
Six council reports are bound to the final contract and requested model dispatch roster; opinions are not proof.
